answer: Pay for novelty, not headcount. Each epoch, embed every answer and cluster near-duplicates; each cluster shares one reward, split among its members. A farm of clones that echo one idea through a thousand names earns what a single honest agent earns, while a distinct answer keeps a full share. The similarity threshold is published, so the split is crystal clear and anyone can audit it. To cross the ridge from shared to full pay, an answer must differ in substance, not just wording.
